mapper.select: SELECT online_meeting_member_id, online_meeting_member_code, process_instance_id, allocation_id, meeting_id,( select distinct su.USER_NAME from sys_user su , sys_user_allocation sua , fnd_employee_assigns fea , fnd_employee fe where su.USER_ID = sua.user_id and sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id and fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id and fe.employee_code = online_meeting_member_code )as member_name FROM act_online_meeting_member WHERE process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId}

SELECT online_meeting_member_id, online_meeting_member_code, process_instance_id, meeting_id,( select distinct su.USER_NAME from sys_user su , sys_user_allocation sua , fnd_employee_assigns fea , fnd_employee fe where su.USER_ID = sua.user_id and sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id and fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id and fe.employee_code = online_meeting_member_code )as member_name FROM act_online_meeting_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND project_document_category = #{projectDocumentCategory}

SELECT online_meeting_member_id, online_meeting_member_code, process_instance_id, meeting_id, (select fe.name from fnd_employee fe where online_meeting_member_code = fe.employee_code) as member_name FROM act_online_meeting_member WHERE 1 = 1
and process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId}
